rationales.fluency: Uses first-person plural instead of singular; structure is somewhat natural but person is wrong.
rationales.grammar: Ta muid is grammatically acceptable (we form) but wrong person; imri is not the standard verb for go; prepositions correct.
rationales.idiom: ag imri is not idiomatic for going to a place; teach-aithean (shop) is reasonable but composed form.
rationales.task_fulfillment: Changes person from I to we; verb choice is non-standard; destination expressed but person error undermines meaning.
